checks.query: SELECT USER AS LOGIN_USER,SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','SERVICE_NAME') AS SERVICE_NAME FROM DUAL
SELECT PRIVILEGE FROM SESSION_PRIVS ORDER BY PRIVILEGE
SELECT ROLE FROM SESSION_ROLES ORDER BY ROLE
SELECT OWNER,TABLE_NAME,PRIVILEGE,GRANTABLE FROM USER_TAB_PRIVS_RECD ORDER BY OWNER,TABLE_NAME,PRIVILEGE
SELECT VIEW_NAME,TEXT FROM ALL_VIEWS WHERE OWNER='PHARMACY' AND VIEW_NAME IN ('V_DRUG_TRACE_CODE','V_DRUG_TRACE_BILL') ORDER BY VIEW_NAME

SELECT business_kind,finalized,is_void,bill_time,expected_code_count FROM PHARMACY.V_DRUG_TRACE_BILL WHERE source_system=:ss AND pharmacy_code=:pharmacy AND business_kind=:kind AND source_bill_id=:bid AND ((:bt IS NULL AND bill_time IS NULL) OR bill_time=:bt) AND ROWNUM<=3
